newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek core inflation said 8.2 pct yr/yr in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Greek core inflation said 8.2 pct yr/yr in Aug.

text.p: Greece's core CPI-based inflation which excludes food and energy prices is estimated to have dropped to 8.2 percent year-on-year in August from 8.5 percent in July, a senior official at a foreign bank told Reuters.
The National Statistics Service (NSS) does not report core inflation figures.
According ot the NSS, The headline consumer price inflation figure eased to 8.5 percent year-on-year in August from 8.6 percent in July.
